report_title: D5.3. Farmers’ and consumers’ preferences and behavioural economics underpinning underutilised crop choices
report_model_scope: Table 6 uses heterogeneous preference coefficients, with cost described as lognormal; reports WTP-space results. These are not the same estimand as a homogeneous MNL coefficient ratio.
units_confirmed: GBP per 250g shortbread package, also confirmed by released workbook metadata row 104.
source_count_discrepancy: Report pages 36/37 state 301 consumers and 1790 choices; published dataset metadata reports 299 respondent records. The reanalysis uses the workbook itself: 299 records, 298 complete six-task respondents, 1788 retained menus. Do not replace the checked workbook counts with the report count.
